results.question: 2016年一共有多少笔已送达订单？
results.a_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-01-01'
results.b_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_status='delivered' AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-01-01'

results.question: 订单金额总和最高的前5个州是哪些？
results.a_sql:
SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 5
results.b_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: 已送达订单平均每单收到几条客户评价？
results.a_sql:
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(r.review_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_reviews_per_order
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
results.b_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_count), 2) AS avg_reviews_per_order FROM (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY o.order_id)

results.question: 在所有支付记录中，boleto银行付款单的平均每笔支付金额是多少？

FROM order_payments
WHERE payment_type = 'boleto'
LIMIT 1000
results.b_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_payment_value FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'boleto'

results.question: 2017年哪个月的订单量最高？
results.a_sql:
SELECT substr(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY substr(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7)
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 1
results.b_sql: SELECT substr(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_status='delivered' AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: 已送达订单中，health_beauty美妆健康品类的总销售额是多少（含运费）？
results.a_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS total_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_category_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND pct.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty'
LIMIT 1000
results.b_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND pct.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty' LIMIT 1000

results.question: 已取消(canceled)的订单总共涉及多少金额？
results.a_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value), 2) AS total_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'canceled'
LIMIT 1000
results.b_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS canceled_order_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'canceled'

results.question: 平均商品单价最高的前3个卖家是谁？
results.a_sql:
SELECT 
    s.seller_id,
    s.seller_city,
    s.seller_state,
    ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS avg_price
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY avg_price DESC
LIMIT 3
results.b_sql: SELECT oi.seller_id, ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS avg_price FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 3
